changelog:
Autodesk-Flue Skill v1.0.0

- Enables command-line control of Autodesk desktop applications (currently 3ds Max) through Flue, a local shell-to-app bridge.
- Allows inspection and bounded editing within Autodesk apps by coding agents, using a consistent stdin/stdout interface.
- Includes setup instructions and clear safety guidance, emphasizing non-destructive, human-guided operations.
- Provides information about extending support to other creative and office applications via the same bridge framework.
display_name: Autodesk 3Ds Max - Agents Help with 3D work
summary: Control Autodesk desktop apps - 3ds Max and friends - from the shell via Flue, without an MCP server.
